title: QuickLab model cards & request-composer screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a compact screenshot and asset pack for QuickLab: a lightweight onboarding flow that demonstrates model selection (model cards), the request-composer UI, and inline client code snippets for JS/Python. Assets should be optimized for use in docs, in-product first-run tour, and marketing one-pagers.
acceptance_criteria: Three high-res model card screenshots: default list, expanded card (details), and tier-filtered view
Two request-composer states: template selection (Chat/Complete/Embed) and an expanded advanced settings panel
Four code snippet image tiles (JS fetch, Node SDK, Python requests, curl) with matching request payload used in the request-composer screenshots
All screenshots available in 1440x900 and 1280x720 variants with clear safe-area margins
Figma file contains redlines, exportable slices, and component tokens; designers and docs can pull assets without edits
UX review signoff from PM and Eng with recorded feedback addressed
